title: changelog-analyst structured status output v1
description: Validates the JSON payload of the '--- CHANGELOG-ANALYST-STATUS-BEGIN ---' / '--- CHANGELOG-ANALYST-STATUS-END ---' response block (agents/changelog-analyst.md '### Output schema' / '### Structured output sentinel'). This schema is a DESCRIPTION of an already-existing, already-correct output format (lane L7 of spec-20260930-092323) -- it formalizes the prose for obligation-block validation (schemas/obligation.v1.json's response_block artifact kind) and does not change what changelog-analyst emits. additionalProperties false at every level: a drifted/unexpected field is a shape bug worth surfacing, not silently accepted.

allOf.description: commit_status committed means every repository this dispatch reports reached a terminal state, committed (with its commit SHA and the push-gate token written) or nothing_to_commit, and none remains: /commit Step 7 reads committed as exactly that (the rule its prose re-checked until P1b moved it here, to the analyst's own stop).

commit_status.description: The outcome of this dispatch's own commit attempt. /commit Step 7's result-handling table branches on this value verbatim -- see commands/commit.md 'Changelog-analyst result handling and retry protocol'.

repository_results.description: Mandatory in normal mode (including dryrun, where each planned repository is represented without a commit SHA); may be omitted only in legacy bulk mode, per the prose this schema describes.

order.description: Position in the ordered REPOSITORY_PLAN -- the transaction boundary is explicit ordered/non-atomic, so order is load-bearing for reconstructing what happened before a partial failure.

repo_root.description: Canonical (realpath'd) repository root this result describes.

status.description: Per-repository outcome -- distinct from the top-level commit_status, which summarizes across all repositories in the plan.

expected_head.description: The plan SHA this repository's commit grant was bound to; used to detect drift between planning and execution.

commit_sha.description: Present only when status == committed. Equals the LAST entry in commits[] (see commits[] for the full per-source-group breakdown when more than one commit landed).

commits.description: Present (non-empty) only when status == committed. One entry per attribution-source group from agents/changelog-analyst.md's Phase 3 item-0 loop, in commit order -- PRIMARY (this cycle's own, including backup-path candidates) first when present, then one entry per distinct multi-source group. A dispatch with no multi-source candidates still has exactly one entry here (source_key: PRIMARY).

source_key.description: "PRIMARY" or the sorted, pipe-joined tuple of every source identifier (ticket/task id or session id) this group's files share.

sources.description: The source identifiers named in source_key, as a list.

paths.description: Repo-relative paths committed in this group.

push_gate_written.description: Whether the push-gate token was written for this repository's new HEAD. /push reads this token; its absence blocks /push even after a successful commit.

reconciled_commit_sha.description: Present only when commit_status == push_gate_reconciled; equals live HEAD. Verified against live HEAD by the /commit caller before treating the gate as open.

reconciliation_basis.description: Present only alongside reconciled_commit_sha. The ONLY accepted attribution is commit_event_journal (a PostToolUse-appended journal entry with verified parent linkage) -- a Task-id trailer, file-set overlap, or subject pattern is never authorizing, so this object's shape matters for trust, not just display.

corroboration.description: Optional, explicitly NON-authorizing observations -- attribution comes from the journal entry fields above, never from this field.

push_gate_reconciliation_declined.description: Present when a tokenless HEAD could not be attributed to this task/session and reconciliation was therefore declined; names the reason (e.g. no_journal_entry).

failure_code.description: Present only when status == failed. Drives /commit's retryable-vs-non-retryable branch.

failure_reason.description: Present only when status == failed. Human-readable detail paired with failure_code.

remaining_repos.description: Canonical paths of repositories not yet attempted; non-empty only when commit_status == partially_committed. /commit never retries these automatically.

auto_bulk_commits.description: Present (and non-empty) only when commit_status == nothing_to_commit_precommitted -- the changes were already landed by a prior auto-bulk commit this dispatch discovered rather than created.

failure_reason.description: Top-level, human-readable failure summary; present for commit_status in {failed, partially_committed}.

failure_code.description: Top-level failure code; present for commit_status in {failed, partially_committed}. For partially_committed this duplicates the first failed repository result for simple consumers that do not walk repository_results[].

baseline_check.description: Written as the charter's 'Requirement baseline' line asks (agents/changelog-analyst.md, top): /commit's dispatch carries no requirement document, so its structured inputs are the baseline. Optional here (not in required[]) because it predates this field.

evidence.description: Cited evidence (file:line or document section) for any verdict other than consistent/not_provided.
